purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 10-record item effect batch 023; together these files contain exactly 10 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/dragonblood-items.name: Dragonblood Items
items/dragonblood-items.effectSummary: Dragonblood-sensitive magic items come in two forms without changing the item’s price or creation cost. Restricted-use items provide their magical functions only to creatures with the dragonblood subtype; other users receive only the item’s mundane qualities. Hidden-potential items function normally for anyone but grant an additional built-in ability to a dragonblooded user, such as a +1 flaming longsword functioning as +1 flaming burst in dragonblooded hands.

items/camellia-of-the-black-lady.name: Camellia of the Black Lady
items/camellia-of-the-black-lady.effectSummary: As a standard action, the wearer designates a humanoid and presses the flower’s stem. When that target comes within 20 feet, it must make Will DC 19 (DC 21 if Selûne is its patron) or be dominated for up to 9 days; it also suffers a no-save remorseless-charm effect suppressing moral restraint. The domination ends if dispelled, the duration expires, or the flower is destroyed. When it ends, poison deals 1d10 Constitution damage immediately and again 1 minute later, each instance negated by Fortitude DC 19 (DC 21 for a Selûne worshiper). The camellia is usable only once.

items/medallions-of-io.name: Medallions of Io
items/medallions-of-io.effectSummary: Pressing a medallion to the brow as a standard action activates it for 1 hour without occupying the head slot; afterward it becomes nonmagical. Black grants acid resistance 10 and +4 Handle Animal with reptiles; Blue electricity resistance 10 and +4 Bluff; Green acid resistance 10 and permits untrained Diplomacy with plant creatures at +5 DC; Red fire resistance 10 and +4 Will against illusions; White cold resistance 10 and +4 Balance; Brass fire resistance 10 and +4 Handle Animal; Bronze electricity resistance 10 and +4 Sense Motive; Copper acid resistance 10 and +4 Perform; Gold fire resistance 10 and +4 Fortitude against ability damage, drain, or penalties; Silver cold resistance 10 and +4 on checks against wind knockdown, overrun, trip, and similar effects.

items/ring-elemental-command-air-68.name: Ring of Elemental Command (air)
items/ring-elemental-command-air-68.effectSummary: Air elementals cannot attack or approach within 5 feet unless the wearer gives up that protection to attempt charm monster (Will DC 17); a failed charm permanently ends that absolute protection and prevents further charm attempts. Air-plane creatures attacking the wearer take -1 on attacks; the wearer gains +2 resistance on saves against their attacks, +4 morale on attacks against them, weapons that bypass their damage reduction, and the ability to converse with them. The wearer takes -2 on saves against earth-based effects. The ring also grants self-only feather fall and electricity resist energy without limit and air walk once per day. It initially appears to be only a ring of feather falling until a DM-set activation condition is met, and each new wearer must activate it again.

items/ring-elemental-command-earth-69.name: Ring of Elemental Command (earth)
items/ring-elemental-command-earth-69.effectSummary: Earth elementals cannot attack or approach within 5 feet unless the wearer gives up that protection to attempt charm monster (Will DC 17); a failed charm permanently ends that absolute protection and prevents further charm attempts. Earth-plane creatures attacking the wearer take -1 on attacks; the wearer gains +2 resistance on saves against their attacks, +4 morale on attacks against them, weapons that bypass their damage reduction, and the ability to converse with them. The wearer takes -2 on saves against air- or lightning-based effects. The ring also grants self-only meld into stone without limit and stoneskin once per week. It initially appears to be only a ring of meld into stone until a DM-set activation condition is met.
